description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git diff behavior, specifically testing the -B and -M options for detecting renames and complete rewrites during diff operations. It sets up a repository state, performs modifications to files, and compares the expected and actual diff outputs to verify correct behavior.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test scenario expecting success, executing the provided setup or test commands.

methods.name: compare_diff_raw
methods.description: Compares the actual diff output with the expected output to verify correctness.
